summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting board composition changes, effective August 1, 2026. The Board elected Mr. Reinaldo Duarte Castanheira Filho as Vice Chairman and appointed Mr. Wilfred Theodoor Bruijn as Lead Independent Director, both independent members. The filing reaffirms commitment to governance and transparency; no financial terms, transactions, or special-situation events are involved. This is a routine governance announcement, not a special situation.
